scope: Market-data providers and data dependencies implemented or explicitly missing in this repository. Status concerns access/authorization evidence; READY additionally requires operational and rights checks.

status_definitions.MISSING: No provider, entitlement, or usable dataset is present for the stated capability.
status_definitions.LICENSED: The owner reports an active subscription or permission; this is not proof of retention, redistribution, or current runtime readiness.
status_definitions.UNVERIFIED: A provider, code path, or local data exists, but authorization, provenance, latency, or retention terms are not evidenced sufficiently.
status_definitions.READY: Authorization and retention scope are documented, credentials/entitlement are operationally verified, and latency/data-quality checks pass.

products: live LTP/OHLC/full quotes and visible top-of-book

access.method: Authenticated read-only GET endpoints; provider module allowlists paths and throttles calls.

credential_flags.name: today_stored_kite_token
credential_flags.observed_from: boolean result of stored-token lookup; value not recorded

access.authorization_evidence: Owner reported paying for Kite Connect API access in this conversation; account entitlement was not independently inspected.

latency.availability: Live quote path retains exchange and receive/availability clocks; historical candles are returned by request.
latency.measurement_gap: No per-request latency distribution, quote staleness report, or exchange-to-receipt clock-skew validation is attached.

retention.gap: API subscription does not by itself establish archival duration, derived-data use, or redistribution rights; the applicable account terms are not filed here.

limitations: Current API key is absent from the process environment, so the stored daily token alone does not make this checkout runtime-ready.
Owner subscription statement is not third-party entitlement evidence.
